reference: util-linux dmesg, run by the harness with Bash as the reference shell and LC_ALL=C; only option errors are compared (status recorded on stdout, stderr bytes), which do not read the kernel log.
coverage: Pass 8 (G120): option errors in GNU form, naming the command only, with the GNU status.

cases.purpose: G120: an unknown long option is reported as dmesg reports it, with no internal builtin name and the GNU status.
G120: an unknown short option is reported as dmesg reports it, with no internal builtin name and the GNU status.

cases.script:
rc=0
dmesg -f || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
rc=0
dmesg --since || rc=$?
echo "rc=$rc"
